notes.title: Major Update 1.02 is live! ✈️
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45696233/ba2adb54ae7b8a8dc0e4be9af4504c24f30aa268.jpg"][/img]
We’ve been working hard on improving [i]Fold & Fly[/i] and are excited to share some big new additions:[/p][p][b]🌍 New Languages[/b]
Fold & Fly is now fully localized in [b]9 new languages[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]Italian[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Russian[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🛩️ New Planes[/b]
Two brand-new plane models with [b]unique stats and flight characteristics[/b]. Try them out and master new flying styles![/p][p][b]🎵 Soundtrack Bundle[/b]
The official [b]Fold & Fly Soundtrack Bundle[/b] is now available, featuring [b]24 original tracks[/b] to accompany your journey.[/p][p][b]⚙️ Performance & Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]General performance improvements across all worlds[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple bug fixes for smoother gameplay[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.01
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45696233/b8d1e1f7fb91c63be2447b7670189ae99af4c90f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello fellow Pilots![/p][p]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback since launch and Patch 1.01 is here to smooth things out with a few key fixes and improvements[/p][p]🔧 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
• Fixed the disappearing plane after long sessions
• Fixed settings not saving between sessions[/p][p]⚙️ [b]New Options[/b]
• Added Motion Blur and V-Sync settings
• Input controls now support arrow keys
• Default graphics setting lowered to High for better first-time performance[/p][p]Thanks for all the kind words and constructive notes, keep them coming!
More updates soon[/p][p]Fly safe
The BW Labs Team[/p]
